release_notes:
Version 3.00 (September 2026)
- Multi-platform Desktop support (Windows, macOS, and Linux) 
- Added dual-theme Light & Dark mode toggle support across all sections and result cards.
- Integrated dynamic asset-specific Cap Rate Heat flow spectrum with live mouse inspection.
- Enhanced Mini CRE Calculators with economic vacancy breakdowns and plain-English guides.
- Added in Math enabled calculation inputs
- Removed Evaluate Button for dynamic calculations
- Added in scroll bar feature to Proforma Calculations, Market Cap Rate Valuation Spectrum
- Tool Tips over hover
- Send over calculation results from mini calculator to input fields
- Added in alternative ways if the Ask price or Cap Rate is not known
- Now able to Export/import deals & generate PDF from all tabs
- Clear Form button added to each form
- Reset to default for Proposed Debt Structure & Targets in Acquisition Screener
- Localization Language Support (English, Spanish, French, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Vietnamese, Russian, Hindi, Portuguese, Arabic, German, Italian, Dutch, Tagalog, Swedish)
